title: scorzoneroides autumnalis var. keretina
intro: Scorzoneroides autumnalis var. keretina, commonly known as Autumn knapweed, is a flowering plant in the sunflower family that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. It is known for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant health benefits, which may help to reduce pain and swelling, as well as protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an antiseptic, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Autumn knapweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
